text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary rollout infer-runtime v2026.3.15 -> 10% across us-west-2 :rocket:
Diane (oncall): getting paged — seeing 502/503 spike on canary hosts, alert firing: `canary-error-rate > 5%` :rotating_light:
Sam (sre): acknowledged, i'm oncall. jumping into logs now. @Maria can you grab recent prod build notes?
Maria (runtime): saw one risky change: `router-priority` tweak + new kv-cache hint enabled in that build. didn't expect it to affect cold start.
Diane (oncall): stack traces show `kv_cache_load` NPE in worker-3. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T21:45:12Z worker-3 inference-runtime ERROR kv_cache_load - nil pointer
at runtime.go:218
```
Sam (sre): ok — initial hypothesis: new kv cache path hits an uninitialized map on certain code paths. this is reproduceable on v2026.3.15 canary only.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-004 — Canary error spike. Paging escalation in 5m if not acked.
Diane (oncall): i'm going to flip the feature flag to kill the new router path and pause the rollout. @Maria please confirm which flag keys control this.
Maria (runtime): `feature.inference.new_router` and `feature.inference.kv_hint`. kill both.
Sam (sre): running kill now — using FF service:
```
curl -X POST https://ff.svc/api/toggle -d '{"key":"feature.inference.new_router","state":"off"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```
Diane (oncall): toggled both flags to `off` at 21:47 UTC.
Kevin (product): noted — any customer-facing impact or visible errors in API?
Lina (cs): we have 3 customer tickets and two top-of-funnel errors reported internally. CS triage queued. will draft short note if degraded persists.
Sam (sre): rolling back canary to previous image v2026.3.14 as safety net. command used:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-runtime inference-runtime=redwood/inference:2026.3.14 --record
```
Sam (sre): also scaling canary down to 0 to stop traffic flow while rollback finishes.
Diane (oncall): telemetry shows error rate dropping already — from 7.2% to 1.1% within 90s of flag flip. nice.
Maria (runtime): confirmed: NPEs stop, kv cache warnings gone. looks like the flag flip mitigated the root path.
incident-bot: Canary rollout paused by Diane (oncall). Automatic retry disabled.
Sam (sre): rolling out single-commit revert PR on main to remove the unsafe kv-cache init as a follow-up — PR #4823 reverts commit `abc1234`. Creating hotfix build.
Maria (runtime): building hotfix image now. CI passing on smoke tests. pushing `redwood/inference:2026.3.15-hotfix1`.
Diane (oncall): CS, Product — please hold external comms until we confirm stable for 30m. Lina, ping if any customer escalations need immediate messaging.
Lina (cs): will watch. drafting a short internal blurb for customer success and the three impacted accounts.
Sam (sre): new image pushed, canary redeploy will be manual and guarded. will do a small canary with additional logging.
Maria (runtime): note for post-incident: need stronger null-safety and unit coverage around kv cache init paths. also add a canary smoke test that hits cold start path.
Diane (oncall): final status update: issue mitigated via feature flag kill + rollback. rolling to resolved after 45m of stable telemetry. no broad customer data loss. impact: elevated 5xx (peak ~7%) affecting ~2% of requests for ~6m.
Kevin (product): thanks all. action items: PR revert + hotfix deploy + add smoke test + postmortem doc. assigning owners. :thumbsup:
Sam (sre): i'll create the postmortem draft and link PR/CI artifacts.
Maria (runtime): i'll own the fix and test.
Lina (cs): i'll follow up with the three impacted customers and update playbook.
Diane (oncall): closing the loop. good quick coordination everyone. :white_check_mark:
